PurrinkShelf: a library for the books on your Supernote, in the spirit of NovelUpdates and Mihon. This is a beta: bug reports and ideas are welcome in Issues.

**Download `PurrinkShelf.snplg` below.** Copy it to the **MyStyle** folder on your Supernote, then **Settings › Apps › Plugins › Add Plugin**. Open any book or note and tap the PurrinkShelf button in the toolbar. The first time, add a library: the gear › **Data and storage** › the folder button. To update later, install the newer file the same way: it replaces the old one and keeps everything.

### What it does
- Libraries from any folders (Supernote or SD card). Subfolders become categories, and `Vol / Part / Chapter` files join into one book.
- Book pages with **Start / Continue**, reading status with dates, and sticky notes with 1–5 star ratings.
- Filter by genre, tag, author or content warnings, and sort by title, last read, added, author or rating. Arrows instead of scrolling.
- Collections with rules, a wishlist, and paper books with lending.
- Profile: books finished per month, an optional yearly goal, time spent reading, reading days, top genres, and a searchable board of every note.
- Fills empty details from the EPUB, from Calibre's `metadata.opf` and `cover.jpg`, or from your own book list (`_Library Data/library.csv`).
- Fill in many books on a computer with `PurrinkShelf books.xlsx` (drop-down lists); with Supernote Cloud Auto Sync there's no copying. Import from or export to Goodreads and StoryGraph.
- **Appearance:** Original, or **Cats**: hand-drawn lines, cat toggles, paw prints on notes and little cats around the pages.
- **Show and hide:** turn parts of the Profile and book pages on or off. **About:** version, license and privacy inside the plugin.
- Automatic backup in `Document/PurrinkShelf`, restored by itself after reinstalling.

### Privacy
No internet, no accounts, no tracking. PurrinkShelf only reads your books (it never changes or deletes them) and keeps its own data on the device. Details are in the README.

Built and tested on a Supernote Nomad (the Manta is untested). Made by vibe-coding with Claude. The walkthrough video below uses made-up demo books.
